test_title: PYST 3: SSC Stenographer - Reasoning (Held On:12 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Seven people, A, B, C, D, E, F and G, are sitting in a straight row, facing north. Only 2 people sit to the left of E. G is an immediate neighbour of E. B sits to the immediate right of F. Only 3 people sit between G and F. A sits to the immediate left of D.

Who sits to the immediate right of E?
solution:
Given: Seven people, A, B, C, D, E, F and G, are sitting in a straight row, facing north.

1) Only 2 people sit to the left of E.

2) G is an immediate neighbour of E.

3) Only 3 people sit between G and F.

4) B sits to the immediate right of F. 

5) A sits to the immediate left of D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cad649a64c719d9f3d41f98dff603f5cd151b5108187acf61fdd8d578668b9bd.png] 

And, C will sit at the remaining place.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3a648adb9ba9d5dc9ff1c4a52afb0ddcbdd7f40e27fcff83daf852e80be46aec.png] 

So, **'A' **sits to the immediate right of E.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
